summary: Full regression + feature verification for launch-readiness tasks. 9/9 pytest endpoint tests pass; 20+ Playwright checks pass across all 3 pages (footer contact + private-email leak check, contact form validation, honest failure handling with preserved values, homepage preview note, mobile nav at 390, FAQ <details> toggling, horizontal-overflow at 1920/390/320). Enquiry endpoint returns correct codes: 400 validation, 422 rejected (honeypot + <2.5s timing), 503 not_configured for valid input, 429 rate_limited on 4th valid attempt. Sitemap returns exactly the 3 canonical production URLs, robots.txt in preview allows crawling and omits sitemap, every page sends X-Robots-Tag noindex,nofollow + meta robots noindex,nofollow,nocache, canonicals point to production.

issues: Homepage canonical is 'https://raystratsystems.com' (no trailing slash) while sitemap loc for root is 'https://raystratsystems.com/' (with slash). Both point to same resource but Google recommends they match exactly. Minor, non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: align homepage canonical trailing slash with sitemap ('/' in both) or vice versa for perfect consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Rate-limit is in-memory (Map) — resets on frontend restart and does not persist across serverless instances. Acceptable for MVP but note for scale.
Route handler correctly returns 503 when RESEND_API_KEY/ENQUIRY_FROM_EMAIL/ENQUIRY_TO_EMAIL missing; failure message preserves user values on client. Good.
middleware.ts sets X-Robots-Tag only for the 3 explicit matcher routes — /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt correctly do NOT get the noindex header, which is correct behaviour.
vp@raystrat.com is only in backend/.env (ENQUIRY_TO_EMAIL) and never referenced in any client-side component — confirmed via HTML scan on all 3 pages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5: All launch-readiness items verified. Backend/API pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_enquiry_api.py (9 tests). NOTE: The 4th test (rate-limit) leaves the shared in-memory limiter tripped — restart frontend (sudo supervisorctl restart frontend) before any subsequent form-submission testing so you see the 503 not_configured message instead of 429 rate_limited. Private recipient vp@raystrat.com is confirmed absent from all rendered HTML.
